slides.heading: Longest Substring Without Duplication
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Hard · Strings
slides.narration: Let's solve Longest Substring Without Duplication, a hard strings problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Sliding window with last-seen index per character.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. Sliding window with last-seen index per character.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: Slide a window; when a character repeats, jump the start past its last occurrence.
slides.narration: Slide a window; when a character repeats, jump the start past its last occurrence.

slides.heading: Brute force vs optimal
bullets: Sliding window with a set → O(n)
Last-seen map lets start jump directly
slides.narration: Checking every substring for duplicates is cubic. A sliding window with a last-seen map lets the start jump past a repeat directly, linear time.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, map characters to last index. Second, move start past a repeat. Third, track the longest window.

slides.caption: 'c' at 0
slides.narration: At c, no repeat. The best is c.

slides.narration: At e, it already appeared in the window, so the start jumps past it to index 3. The best is clem.

slides.narration: At p, no repeat. The best is mentisac.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: For each index, if the character's last position is within the window, move start past it. Update last and the best.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n. Space is O of min(n, a).

slides.heading: Edge cases & pitfalls
slides.narration: Only move the start if the previous occurrence is inside the window.

slides.heading: Interview tips & follow-ups
slides.narration: A fixed-size array works as the map for ASCII.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: Slide a window; when a character repeats, jump the start past its last occurrence.
slides.narration: To recap Longest Substring Without Duplication: Slide a window; when a character repeats, jump the start past its last occurrence. Try re-implementing it from scratch without looking.
